title: AEO
content: Answer engine optimization (AEO) is work intended to help a brand or its content appear in answers from search engines and AI assistants.

meta.why: Decide what you are after before you brief the work. A source link, a brand mention, a recommendation, and a visit are four different outcomes, and each one needs its own measurement.
meta.example: A content team improves its delivery-policy page so a buyer can find the shipping cutoff and the conditions that apply.
meta.check: Choose a buyer question and, before changing the page, record the answer, its linked sources, and whether your brand is named.
meta.limitation: AEO and GEO overlap in industry usage. Google describes both as work on AI search visibility within SEO, and neither one is a separate Google eligibility standard.
meta.sources: Google Search Central: optimizing for generative AI | https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide | Platform documentation
